title: TorusGuardRemediation
description: Standard remediation guidance schema for TorusGuard v0.5.0 findings.

problem_statement.description: Direct, single-sentence summary of the flaw in the current implementation.

risk_explanation.description: Explains how an adversary can abuse this pattern and the concrete security impact.

recommended_fix.description: Clear, prescriptive step-by-step instructions to remediate the vulnerability.

framework.description: Target framework or ecosystem (e.g. Django, DRF, FastAPI, Flask, SQLAlchemy, Express, Next.js).

unsafe_snippet.description: Illustrative code demonstrating the unsafe pattern.

least_invasive.description: True if the remediation preserves existing architectural patterns without unnecessary rewrites.

verification_method.description: How a human engineer or automated test can verify that the fix was applied successfully.

residual_risk_notes.description: Known edge cases, out-of-band requirements (e.g. cloud IAM, reverse proxy headers), or operational trade-offs.
